Samantha / Raj — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our side and requests so procurement can start the vendor intake: 

1) Stakeholders we identified today (please confirm titles/approvers):
   - Economic buyer: Raj Patel (confirmed)
   - Procurement lead: procurement@elicoinc.com (please confirm owner)
   - Security/Infosec reviewer: will you share the contact?

2) Ask list for vendor onboarding (attached):
   - Completed vendor intake form [Attachment: redwood-vendor-intake.pdf]
   - Redwood Tax ID & W-9 (we can attach upon request)
   - Sample invoice & billing instructions
   - Standard SLA overview and data-handling summary [Attachment: redwood-sla-summary.pdf]

3) Commercial items to align on:
   - FYI we quote on monthly usage; typical PO cadence customers use is monthly recurring PO or an annual blanket PO + monthly invoices.
   - Payment terms: default Net 30; we can be flexible (net 45) for enterprise finance with an agreed statement of work / order.

Can you confirm: who owns the vendor intake form at Elico, any mandatory vendor docs beyond a W-9, and a target PO date (tentative)? Once we have the procurement contact, I can push the completed intake and sample invoice.

Thanks — looping in Lauren for billing/account details.

—

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & vendor intake items (Redwood <> Elico)

Priyom — great demo yesterday, thanks. Quick answers below and a couple of asks from my side.

1) Procurement owner: preliminary owner is Maya Singh in Procurement (procurement@elicoinc.com). I'll ask Maya to introduce herself.
2) Required docs: Finance needs a completed vendor intake form, a W-9 (for US vendors), and a copy of your standard invoice template. Legal typically runs a quick T&Cs check but the majority of work is handled by Procurement.
3) Timeline: target internal procurement review in 2 weeks, with a hope to have a PO by end of month (depends on legal review).

I've attached Elico's vendor requirements checklist for vendors to confirm (internal doc).

Couple of clarifying Qs:
- Do you accept electronic invoices via vendor portal or do you require emailed PDFs?
- Does Redwood have a preferred billing address / remit-to we should put on a PO?

Thanks — I will introduce Maya to the thread shortly.

Best,
Samantha
Director, Product Partnerships
Elico Health Systems
[Attachment: elicoinc-vendor-requirements.pdf]

Thanks Samantha — onboarding answers inline and attachments included.

- Billing & invoicing: we support emailed PDF invoices and EDI/vendor-portal uploads. Attached is a sample invoice (PDF) we send monthly. [Attachment: sample_invoice.pdf]
- Billing address / remit-to: Redwood Inference, 420 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105 (we can provide a specific AP code if required).
- Tax ID & W-9: will attach W-9 in the next email (finance needs filtered access — copying Lauren who owns billing).
- Payment terms: we generally operate Net 30 but can accept Net 45 for enterprise contracts where procurement/legal require additional routing.

Vivek (@Vivek) — can you confirm the short security summary attached answers the typical Infosec checks Elico runs? If there's a specific security questionnaire I should fill, please flag it and we'll return within 48 hours.

Next step from our side: I'll complete the vendor intake and share a filled PDF + W-9 for Maya/procurement. Can you confirm a target PO approval date (EOD Aug 17 works on our side as a tentative milestone)?

—
Priyom Das

Hello Priyom / Samantha,

Maya Singh here from Elico Procurement — thanks for the introduction, Samantha. Welcome.

Quick list of what Procurement requires to create a vendor record and route for PO: 
- Completed vendor intake form (fillable PDF)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax form)
- Company legal name and DUNS (if available)
- Proof of insurance (certificate of insurance) for services > $50k annually
- Primary AP contact and invoice delivery method (email or portal)

If Redwood can provide the small set above and a sample invoice, I can create the vendor record and aim to route for approvals. Our standard payment terms are Net 30 but we can process Net 45 upon exec approval.

Attaching the procurement intake form that we ask suppliers to complete. Please send the completed form back to procurement@elicoinc.com and cc samantha.ng@elicoinc.com.

Regards,
Maya Singh
Senior Procurement Manager
Elico Health Systems
